create_camera_rays: create camera ray directions from intrinsics using ray_dirs_C with batch size, height, width, fx, fy, cx, cy
transform_rays_to_world: transform camera rays to world coordinates using origin_dirs_W with a camera-to-world transform matrix
build_look_at_transform: build a camera rotation and translation from eye, target, and up vectors using the look_at function
generate_pointcloud_from_depth: generate a 3D point cloud from a depth image using pointcloud_from_depth with camera intrinsics
estimate_normals_from_pointcloud: estimate surface normals from a 3D point cloud tensor using estimate_pointcloud_normals
